name: Biopsychology, Cognition, and Neuroscience (BCN)
school: College of Literature, Science, and the Arts

requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: All credits completed at U-M plus posted transfer credit.

requirements.label: 100 LSA Credits
requirements.hint: Credits from courses recognized by LSA (most U-M courses except some SI offerings and other school-specific courses).

requirements.label: 60 BS-Eligible Credits (for BS students only)
requirements.hint: Only counts for students pursuing a Bachelor of Science.

requirements.label: 90 Credits Excluding Experiential and Independent Study Courses
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must come from standard coursework; internships and independent study don't count.

requirements.label: 60 Credits outside Psychology
requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the Psychology department(s).

requirements.label: 90 Credits of Graded Course Work, Including Transfer and Test
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must carry a letter grade (transfer and test credit included).

requirements.label: 60 Credits of In-Residence Course Work (AA Campus and U-M Study Abroad)
requirements.hint: Credits taken on the Ann Arbor campus or through an approved U-M study abroad program.

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.hint: 1 QR1 or 2 QR2 courses required

requirements.label: Language Requirement

requirements.hint: From approved CE-designated courses.

requirements.label: Introductory Psychology
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: PSYCH 111, PSYCH 112, or PSYCH 114. C or better. PSYCH 115 (Honors intro) also satisfies this per the department worksheet.

requirements.label: Statistics
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: DATASCI 101, STATS 250, or STATS 280. C- or better.

requirements.label: PSYCH 230: Introduction to Behavioral Neuroscience
requirements.hint: Biopsychology core course.

requirements.label: PSYCH 240: Introduction to Cognitive Psychology
requirements.hint: Cognitive Psychology core course.

requirements.label: Breadth: 1 Course from Approved List
requirements.hint: Choose one of PSYCH 235, 250, 270, 280, 290, or 291 (the WGS 291 cross-listed section counts the same), per the LSA bulletin BCN major page and the Psychology department's BCN Major Worksheet (effective Fall 2021 through present, updated 12/11/24). Additional breadth courses do not count toward the major credits.

requirements.label: Lab Requirement: 5 Credits
requirements.hint: 2 courses and at least 5 credits from the approved lab lists in the Psychology department's BCN Major Worksheet (effective Fall 2021 through present, updated 12/11/24). Each lab must be at least 2 credits in a single term, at least one must be a PSYCH course, and only one non PSYCH bio lab (BIOLOGY, EEB, MCDB) may be used. PSYCH 211 and PSYCH 306 count only in Biopsychosocial Health sections. Labs graded credit/no credit (such as PSYCH 322) satisfy the category but their credits do not count toward the 32 major credits.

requirements.label: Methods-Based Lab
requirements.hint: One methods-based lab from list A in the Psychology department's BCN Major Worksheet (effective Fall 2021 through present, updated 12/11/24). The thesis courses PSYCH 426 and 429 also fulfill the methods lab; see an advisor to use thesis courses for lab credit.

requirements.label: Additional Methods or Experiential Lab
requirements.hint: One more lab, either methods-based (list A) or research/experiential (list B), per the Psychology department's BCN Major Worksheet (effective Fall 2021 through present, updated 12/11/24). The thesis courses PSYCH 424 and 428 fulfill the experiential lab. Only one non PSYCH bio lab may be used across the two labs.

requirements.label: Cognate Course
requirements.hint: One course from the approved cognate list in the Psychology department's BCN Major Worksheet (effective Fall 2021 through present, updated 12/11/24), or a PSYCH 300 or 400 level lecture or seminar course that is not on the BCN advanced course list. Lab, research, and independent study PSYCH courses do not qualify for the PSYCH option, and neither do advanced-list courses, so confirm a PSYCH pick with your advisor.

requirements.label: Advanced Coursework: 12 Credits
requirements.hint: 4 courses and at least 12 credits from the BCN advanced course list in the Psychology department's BCN Major Worksheet (effective Fall 2021 through present, updated 12/11/24): 2 courses at the 300 level and 1 at the 400 level, plus 1 more from the list. PSYCH 420 may not be the only 400 level course. New topics offerings are added on the department's term course charts (Course Information page).

requirements.label: Advanced 300-Level: 2 Courses
requirements.hint: 2 courses at the 300 level from the BCN advanced course list in the Psychology department's BCN Major Worksheet (effective Fall 2021 through present, updated 12/11/24). Cross-listed sections (NEURO, LING, ANTHRBIO, ELI) count the same as their PSYCH number.

requirements.label: Advanced 400-Level: 1 Course
requirements.hint: 1 course at the 400 level from the BCN advanced course list in the Psychology department's BCN Major Worksheet (effective Fall 2021 through present, updated 12/11/24). PSYCH 420 may not be the only 400 level course, so it is not counted for this slot; it can fill the additional advanced course slot instead.

requirements.label: Advanced Additional 300-Level or Above: 1 Course
requirements.hint: 1 more course from the BCN advanced course list (300 level or above) in the Psychology department's BCN Major Worksheet (effective Fall 2021 through present, updated 12/11/24).

requirements.label: Major Total Credits: 32 Minimum
requirements.hint: Minimum 32 credits from courses used toward the major, including approved non PSYCH labs and cognates and cross-listed sections. Any PSYCH course at the 300 level or above may make up the total, per the Psychology department's BCN Major Worksheet (effective Fall 2021 through present, updated 12/11/24). Prerequisites (introductory psychology and statistics), 100 level courses, and courses graded credit/no credit do not count toward the 32.

requirements.label: Upper-Level Residency: 12 Credits In-Residence
requirements.hint: Minimum 12 upper-level credits must be completed in-residence (AA Campus Department of Psychology and U-M Study Abroad).

requirements.label: Residency: 24 Credits In-Residence
requirements.hint: Minimum 24 credits must be completed in-residence (AA Campus Department of Psychology and U-M Study Abroad). Can include the introductory PSYCH course.
